name: AI-Care – Brique lettre validée (ajout au RAG)

parameters.query: SELECT v.id AS validation_id, v.patient_id, b.id AS brouillon_id, (SELECT f->>'ref' FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.faits) f WHERE f->>'id' = 'L1') AS lettre_ref, (b.texte_ia LIKE '%Aucune contradiction détectée%') AS sans_contradiction FROM soins.validations v JOIN soins.brouillons b ON b.id = v.brouillon_id WHERE v.id = $1::bigint AND v.action = 'verifier_document'

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 50, with_payload: true, with_vector: false, filter: { must: [{ key: 'source_ref', match: { value: $json.lettre_ref } }] } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ payload: { statut: 'valide' }, filter: { must: [{ key: 'source_ref', match: { value: $('Décider').first().json.lettre_ref } }] } }) }}
